title: Injection of Teriparatide to Prevent Hypocalcemia After Parathyroidectomy in Dialysis Patients (TeriCa).
brief_summary: This is a pilot randomized controlled trial aimed to evaluate the effect of teriparatide on the clinical course of hypocalcemia after parathyroidectomy for secondary hyperparathyroidism in dialysis-dependent patients.
condition: Chronic Kidney Disease-Mineral and Bone Disorder
